titulo.estudio: Réserver par écrit : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: Booking in writing: vocabulary and forms

intro: Interpret requests, availability and conditions in booking messages. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Interpret requests, availability and conditions in booking messages. Link the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Point to note: « Serait-il possible de… » softens a request; the date and duration details limit the scope of the answer. In this passage, «disponible» means «available».
